reports.title: SpyGlass Pharma Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Corporate Updates

desk.headline: Loss of $0.73 a share, wider than expected; $216m cash funds plans through 2028
results: SpyGlass has no product sales; the net loss rose to $24.3m from $9.8m, driven mainly by administrative costs jumping to $16.2m on professional fees and staff.
Loss per share of $0.73 compares with $4.53 a year ago, when far fewer shares were in issue before the IPO.
In October it bought lens maker Advanced Vision Science from Santen for about $13m in cash, securing supply for its lead glaucoma implant.
Four-year early-trial data showed a 37% cut in eye pressure, with 86% of patients off daily drops; Phase 3 enrolment is on track to finish in 2027.

guidance.summary: No financial guidance. The company expects its $215.8m of cash and short-term investments to fund planned operations through 2028.

watch: Completion of Phase 3 enrolment for the BIM-IOL System in 2027.
Early safety and eye-pressure data from the BIM-DRS first-in-human trial, expected in 2027.
Cost impact of the AVS manufacturing acquisition.
